source:
@@U01356@@
Who cares?
Sign it and you're done with it.

@@U01358@@
If this is the way you operate,
your scheme’s as well as done itself in.

@@U01360@@
Ah, the sanctity of the man!
It’s you all over!
It’s the first time, is it,
you've borne false witness?
You haven't, I suppose,
with your oh so great and mighty powers,
propounded definitions of God and the world
and the forces that move it at its inmost core,
of man and man’s heart,
man’s head and soul,
and what goes on there?
Done so, I dare say,
without a qualm or a blush?
And yet, if you looked
deep and hard in your own soul
you'd have to confess you knew as much about that
as you know of 施韦尔特莱因’s death.

@@U01362@@
Sophist and liar you are and always will be!

@@U01364@@
Yes, well; at least I won't be lonely.
For tomorrow, in all sincerity,
you'll be proving our little 格蕾琴 a fool
with vows of love and other such nonsense.

@@U01366@@
Yes, and with all my heart!
translation:
@@U01356@@
谁在乎？
签名后就完成了。

@@U01358@@
如果这就是你的运作方式，
你的计划已经完成了。

@@U01360@@
啊，男人的神圣！
全部都是你了！
这是第一次吧，
你作过假见证吗？
我想你还没有，
凭借你如此伟大而强大的力量，
提出了上帝和世界的定义
以及推动其最核心的力量，
人与人的心，
人的头脑和灵魂，
那里发生了什么？
这样做，我敢说，
没有疑虑或脸红吗？
然而，如果你看
在你自己的灵魂深处和坚硬
你必须承认你对此了解得同样多
正如你所知道的施韦尔特莱因之死。

@@U01362@@
你现在是，而且永远都是诡辩家和骗子！

@@U01364@@
是的，好吧；至少我不会孤单。
为了明天，满怀诚意，
你会证明我们的小格蕾琴是个傻瓜
爱的誓言和其他类似的废话。

@@U01366@@
是的，我全心全意！
